content.short: TON Planets is an economic simulator and metaverse set on Mars, featuring resource management and trading.
content.description: TON Planets is an expansive economic simulation game and metaverse set on a virtual Mars, built on the TON blockchain. Players can own land, manage colonies, extract valuable resources, and trade assets within a complex, player-driven economy. Every planet, resource, and building is represented as an NFT, ensuring true ownership for participants. TON Planets offers a deep and immersive Play-to-Earn experience where strategic planning and resource management are key to building a successful Martian civilization.
content.meta: Settle on Mars and build your empire in TON Planets. Immersive economic metaverse on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
